headlines.summary_en: Overnight London spot precious metals traded with a firm tone amid volatility. Focus on Fed Chair Warsh's speech at the Jackson Hole global central bank symposium tonight—the most important policy signaling window before the September FOMC meeting. This week's US core PCE data showed inflation retreat stalling and stickiness emerging, widening market divergence on September rate hike expectations. Hawkish voices within the Fed have been intensifying recently; three Fed officials warned yesterday that current rates may be too loose and inflationary pressures still need addressing. Meanwhile, long-end US Treasury yields hover at highs, compounded by Treasury buyback-related bond market disruptions, leaving the dollar and real rates swinging—watch the impact of rate pricing on gold. headlines.title_en: Wall Street CN Breakfast | August 28, 2026
headlines.summary_en: US stocks rebounded, Nasdaq closed up 1.6%, Nvidia surged nearly 9% post-earnings, software stocks rallied; oil reversed a three-day losing streak, Brent briefly rose nearly 3%. Trump signed an executive order renaming Lake Ontario on the US-Canada border to 'Lake of the United States,' and floated renaming the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans. US-Canada tariff standoff continues: Canada adjusted its retaliation list, imposing 50% tariffs on items like copper wire and charcoal. Three Fed officials warned current rates may still be too loose, with inflationary pressures needing action. Iran-Oman diplomatic mediation is showing early results, with Strait of Hormuz shipping volumes quietly recovering to 75% of pre-war levels. Report: Venezuela deepens ties with the US, considering leaving OPEC after decades of membership. China launches special campaign to improve automotive product quality. China's January-July industrial enterprises above designated size saw profits up 17.6% year-on-year; integrated circuit industry profits up

headlines.title: 商务部：推动人工智能等数智技术更好赋能服务贸易发展
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月28日讯，商务部副部长鄢东8月28日在国新办新闻发布会上表示，我们将坚持创新驱动，提升生产性服务国际竞争力，推动研发、设计、检测、维修、供应链物流等依托制造业优势的服务出口，促进服务贸易与高端制造业融合发展。激发生活性服务出口潜力，扩大入境消费，促进文化贸易提质增效，推动人工智能、云计算等数智技术更好赋能服务贸易发展。我们将加快建设国家服务贸易创新发展示范区，稳妥有序推动以服务业为重点扩大市场准入和开放领域，完善跨境服务贸易负面清单管理制度，破除跨境服务贸易壁垒。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Promote AI and other digital-intelligent technologies to better empower service trade development
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data August 28—Vice Minister of Commerce Yan Dong said at a State Council Information Office press conference on August 28: We will stick to innovation-driven development, enhance the international competitiveness of producer services, promote exports of services backed by manufacturing strengths such as R&D, design, testing, maintenance, and supply chain logistics, and foster integrated development of services trade with high-end manufacturing. We will unlock the export potential of consumer services, expand inbound consumption, boost the quality and efficiency of cultural trade, and better empower services trade development with digital-intelligent technologies like artificial intelligence and cloud computing. We will accelerate the construction of national demonstration zones for services trade innovation and development, steadily and orderly expand market access and opening in services as a priority, improve the negative list management system for cross-border services trade, and remove barriers to cross-border services trade.

headlines.title: 苹果公司：iCloud贵州项目健康发展 将持续投资贵州深耕数字经济
headlines.summary: 8月27日，贵州省委副书记、省长李炳军会见出席2026中国国际大数据产业博览会的美国苹果公司副总裁、大中华区董事总经理葛越一行。李炳军表示，希望苹果公司进一步加大在黔投资布局，不断巩固良好合作基础，推动取得更多务实成果。贵州将为包括苹果公司在内的广大外资企业在黔发展提供优质服务。葛越表示，苹果公司iCloud项目落地贵州以来实现持续健康发展，苹果公司愿持续投资贵州、深耕数字经济发展，为中国用户提供世界一流的服务。（证券时报）

headlines.title_en: Apple: iCloud Guizhou project developing healthily, will continue investing in Guizhou to deepen digital economy
headlines.summary_en: On August 27, Li Bingjun, Deputy Secretary of the Guizhou Provincial Party Committee and Governor, met with Isabel Ge Mahe, Vice President of Apple Inc. and Managing Director of Greater China, who attended the 2026 China International Big Data Industry Expo. Li Bingjun expressed hope that Apple would further increase investment and presence in Guizhou, continue consolidating the strong cooperation foundation, and achieve more practical results. Guizhou will provide quality services for foreign-funded enterprises like Apple operating there. Ge Mahe said Apple's iCloud project in Guizhou has achieved sustained healthy development since its launch, and Apple is willing to continue investing in Guizhou, deepen its presence in the digital economy, and deliver world-class services to Chinese users. (Securities Times)

headlines.title: 今年1至7月全国社会物流总额214.5万亿元 同比增长5.0%
headlines.summary: 今年1—7月份，全国社会物流总额214.5万亿元，同比增长5.0%。社会物流总额保持稳定增长，需求结构有所优化。工业品物流基本盘稳定，结构升级态势愈发明显。1—7月份，工业品物流总额同比增长5.3%。其中，传统采矿类物流需求偏弱，而制造业物流仍为增长核心引擎。7月份制造业相关物流需求同比增长5.5%，增速较全部工业品物流高出1个百分点。其中，装备制造物流需求同比增长12.3%，高技术制造相关物流需求增长16.9%。

headlines.title_en: From January to July this year, national social logistics volume totaled 214.5 trillion yuan, up 5.0% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: From January to July this year, China's total social logistics volume reached 214.5 trillion yuan, up 5.0% year-on-year. Total social logistics volume maintained steady growth, with an optimized demand structure. Industrial product logistics remains stable, with an increasingly clear trend of structural upgrading. From January to July, industrial product logistics volume rose 5.3% year-on-year. Among this, traditional mining-related logistics demand was weak, while manufacturing logistics remains the core growth engine. In July, manufacturing-related logistics demand grew 5.5% year-on-year, 1 percentage point higher than total industrial product logistics. Equipment manufacturing logistics demand rose 12.3%, and high-tech manufacturing-related logistics demand grew 16.9%.

headlines.title: 国家发改委：促进集成电路产业高质量发展 我国集成电路关键核心技术新突破
headlines.summary: 国家发改委今天表示，从今年的情况看，我国集成电路产业发展呈现四方面突出特点。一是关键核心技术不断取得突破。高端芯片设计和制造能力持续提升，功率半导体、化合物半导体等特色工艺加快形成差异化竞争优势，先进封装、存储器等领域加速突破。二是企业竞争力持续增强，截至8月27日，已披露财报的上市公司上半年营收同比增长12.8%，净利润同比增长99%；相关企业积极布局新技术研发，研发投入同比增长13.4%。全行业投资扩产同步提速，今年前7个月，集成电路制造业投资同比增长11.5%，发展后劲充足。三是产能利用率保持高位。上半年国内主要晶圆代工企业产能利用率均保持在90%

headlines.title_en: National Development and Reform Commission: Promote high-quality development of integrated circuit industry, China achieves new breakthroughs in key core technologies
headlines.summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC) said today that China's integrated circuit industry has shown four notable characteristics this year. First, breakthroughs in key core technologies continue. High-end chip design and manufacturing capabilities keep improving, specialty processes like power semiconductors and compound semiconductors are rapidly building differentiated competitive advantages, and advanced packaging and memory are accelerating breakthroughs. Second, enterprise competitiveness continues to strengthen—as of August 27, listed companies that have disclosed financials saw first-half revenue up 12.8% year-on-year and net profit up 99%; related firms are actively positioning for new technology R&D, with R&D investment up 13.4%. Industry-wide investment and capacity expansion are accelerating, with integrated circuit manufacturing investment up 11.5% in the first seven months, providing ample momentum. Third, capacity utilization remains high—domestic major wafer foundries maintained utilization above 90% in the first half.

headlines.title: 发改委：发展机器人产业必须因地制宜，防止盲目跟风、一哄而上
headlines.summary: 国家发展改革委政策研究室副主任李超在发改委8月份例行发布会上表示，机器人产业涉及人工智能、先进制造、新材料等诸多前沿技术，必须因地制宜，健康有序发展，立足本地的资源禀赋和产业优势，找准定位，发挥优势，防止盲目跟风、一哄而上，切实推动相关行业行稳致远。

headlines.title_en: NDRC: Developing robotics industry must adapt to local conditions, avoid blind imitation and rushing in
headlines.summary_en: Li Chao, Deputy Director of the Policy Research Office of the National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC), said at the August routine press conference that the robotics industry involves numerous frontier technologies such as artificial intelligence, advanced manufacturing, and new materials. It must develop in a healthy and orderly manner tailored to local conditions, based on local resource endowments and industrial strengths, identify proper positioning, leverage advantages, and prevent blind imitation and herd behavior, effectively promoting steady and long-term industry development.

headlines.summary: 国家发展改革委今天表示，从今年的情况看，我国集成电路产业发展呈现四方面突出特点。一是关键核心技术不断取得突破。二是企业竞争力持续增强。三是产能利用率保持高位。四是产业链安全水平显著提升。下一步将继续聚焦“十五五”规划《纲要》部署要求，发挥新型举国体制优势，全链条推动集成电路关键核心技术攻关取得决定性突破，促进集成电路产业高质量发展，为推动中国经济持续向新向优向好发展做出更大贡献。（央视财经）

headlines.title_en: NDRC: Promote decisive breakthroughs in core technologies for integrated circuits across the entire chain and advance high-quality development of the IC industry
headlines.summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC) said today that China's integrated circuit industry has shown four notable characteristics this year. First, continuous breakthroughs in key core technologies. Second, steadily strengthened enterprise competitiveness. Third, capacity utilization remains high. Fourth, significantly enhanced supply chain security. Going forward, it will continue to focus on the deployment requirements of the '15th Five-Year Plan' outline, leverage the advantage of the new nationwide system for mobilizing resources, and drive decisive breakthroughs in key core technologies across the entire integrated circuit chain, promote high-quality development of the integrated circuit industry, and contribute more to China's sustained economic progress toward innovation and excellence. (CCTV Finance)

headlines.title_en: NDRC: Increase support for private investment projects, promote construction of six networks and 'Two Major' initiatives
headlines.summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC) said today that it has recently organized a series of special meetings to intensify efforts to promote effective investment. Regarding new policy-based financial instruments, it is coordinating relevant parties to accelerate the disbursement of financial instrument funds and increase support for private investment projects. On 'six networks' construction, it is studying improvements to diversified investment and financing models, refining fiscal, financial, investment, and pricing support policies by category, optimizing the policy mix, and accelerating major project starts. Meanwhile, focusing on the integration of computing networks, new power grids, and next-generation communication networks, it is studying the establishment of a '2+3+N' coordination mechanism involving 2 power grid companies, 3 telecom operators, and several computing enterprises, strengthening coordination and synergy. (CCTV Finance)

headlines.title: 国家发改委：“中国挤压”论调完全站不住脚，未来中国还将持续为世界发展和人类进步贡献更大力量
headlines.summary: 国家发展改革委政策研究室副主任李超在发改委8月份例行发布会上表示，所谓“中国挤压”是基于零和博弈对中国的又一次攻击抹黑，目的是为了维护自身霸权，攻击乃至否定别国的正当发展权，破坏全球合作大局。中国用实际行动为发展中国家的工业化、绿色化发展搭梯子，中国贡献实实在在，中国机遇可感可及。今年前7个月，中国与180多个国家和地区的进出口都保持了增长，未来中国还将持续为世界发展和人类进步贡献更大的力量。

headlines.title_en: NDRC: The 'China squeeze' narrative is entirely unfounded; China will continue to contribute greater strength to world development and human progress
headlines.summary_en: Li Chao, deputy director of the Policy Research Office of the National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC), said at the commission's regular August press conference that the so-called 'China squeeze' is another attack and smear against China based on zero-sum game thinking, aimed at maintaining its own hegemony, attacking and even denying other countries' legitimate right to development, and undermining the overall global cooperation landscape. China has taken concrete actions to build ladders for the industrialization and green development of developing countries, with tangible contributions and accessible opportunities. In the first seven months of this year, China's imports and exports with over 180 countries and regions have maintained growth, and China will continue to contribute greater strength to world development and human progress in the future.

headlines.title: 分析人士：科技股调整并非单一美债驱动 AI远期定价成核心博弈主线
headlines.summary: 近期，全球科技板块波动加剧。美国长端国债收益率快速上行，一度对成长股估值形成明显压制；随着债券收益率阶段性回落、英伟达交出超预期财报，美股及A股科技板块又迎来反弹。分析人士认为，利率变化是影响科技股风险偏好和估值水平的重要因素，但不能将本轮调整简单归因于美债收益率高企。随着AI产业进入大规模资本开支与商业化验证阶段，市场博弈的核心正由算力需求的真实性，转向商业化空间、技术领先程度以及远期盈利兑现能力。后续科技行情或由普遍抬升转向分化，订单、业绩与现金流将成为筛选资产的重要依据。（中证报）

headlines.title_en: Analysts: Tech stock adjustment is not solely driven by US Treasuries; long-term AI pricing becomes the core battleground
headlines.summary_en: Recently, global tech sector volatility has intensified. The rapid rise in long-term U.S. Treasury yields once put significant pressure on growth stock valuations; however, as bond yields pulled back temporarily and Nvidia delivered better-than-expected earnings, both U.S. and A-share tech sectors rebounded. Analysts believe that interest rate changes are an important factor affecting tech stock risk appetite and valuations, but this round of adjustment cannot be simply attributed to high U.S. Treasury yields. As the AI industry enters a stage of large-scale capital expenditure and commercialization validation, the core of market gaming is shifting from the authenticity of computing power demand to commercialization space, technological leadership, and the ability to realize long-term profitability. Going forward, tech market trends may shift from broad-based gains to divergence, with orders, earnings, and cash flow becoming important criteria for asset selection. (China Securities Journal)
